Full EnvironmentForces wind field, scene-hit probes, point lights/shadows, model shaders, startup/camera and original compositor/Tonemap remain.

Avatar/model automatic emission state and game RNG, full source preparation/interaction forces, original registration order, real Visibility occlusion classification/buffers and full wind field, opaque scene depth production, actual water/blue noise and history/reprojection, viewport integration, original Metal boundary interpolation/intrinsic/contraction and half overflow acceptance. CloudCard quarter-acos/28-byte dynamic streams using actual TGCL alphaMult and CloudBarn world move/scroll are recovered, including native byte and real-card GPU checks. Complete insertion/reset/model emission helpers and physics-sphere append pass 424 native cases, nearest-three selection passes 593 cases and integration passes 400 cases. Particle lifetime ring, 32-byte post-physics packing and original signed-depth uint16 permutations are also recovered; model state/random stream and preceding force inputs remain explicit. A snapshot runtime chains queue consumption, lifetime, integration, packing and sorting without default forces. Native target descriptors/sizes/formats and earlier opaque CloudCore read are recovered; nine cloud/depth AIR runtime programs and three-pass native depth IPC are implemented, with same-pass fine + explicit ordered CloudCard/particle batch IPC and original CloudCard world sphere/overlap components, exact original group/distance permutations, shared index offsets, six normalized frustum planes, sphere tests and original unstable status compaction connected to distance draw queue IPC. Visibility classification statuses and stored CPU frustum matrix are explicit inputs; the external classifier is excluded from the passing oracle. True half pass RTE reference remains failed; current llvmpipe RTZ reproduction is exact but original Metal conversion is unverified. Two-level cloud and connected depth/cloud fixtures pass; quarter sampling is exact with captured Vulkan UV while independent CPU raster has boundary differences.
